title: The folder, returned
logline: The (finch) folder on the returns cart, on top of two novels and a road atlas, the card's pocket showing. Somebody had it out in 2022. The page adds nothing to the card; the stamp is reserved.

panels.composition: A library returns cart with a gray folder on top of two hardback novels and a road atlas, a card pocket visible on the folder's inside cover.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a library returns cart holding a gray folder on top of two hardback novels and a road atlas with a card pocket visible inside the folder's cover, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
